title: wg: content-09 §6.3/§9.1 depth and part-count counting rules
description: Suggestion. "NestedParts MUST NOT be nested more than 4-levels deep" (L1928) doesn't say whether the root is level 1; §9.1 "more than 1024" body parts (L2376) doesn't say whether MultiPart containers count. mimid counts root as level 1 and every NestedPart (decisions mimid-1wgh.2.13, .2.21). Fix: define both.
